correctness.rationale: Correctness PASS for K=M(Petersen), where vertices are the 15 Petersen edges and faces are pairwise disjoint-edge matchings. Freshly built complete simplicial chain groups with face vector (15,75,145,90,6); signed integer boundary ranks (14,61,79,6), and every nonzero Smith factor unit, prove reduced H2=Z^5 and reduced H3=Z^5. The general flag-cycle minimum-support theorem requires at least six vertices for nonzero H2, and at six support the carrier is an induced 3-crosspolytope boundary. Exhaustively inspected all binom(15,6)=5005 supports, found exactly110 incompatibility-perfect-matching octahedra. All eight-triangle join fundamental cycles have zero boundary. Enumerated all 120 S5 permutations, giving orbit sizes (10,60,40). Independent Smith reductions on matrices [D3|orbit cycles] have 84 nonzero factors and nonunit lists (2),(),(), proving exact integral quotients; one representative in each orbit is nonzero primitive with an 80-unit-factor augmented matrix. Source program also constructs seven conjugacy-type characters and rational representation identification; this character calculation was inspected but not independently replayed in this execution, so the latter rests on the explicit signed chain-action formula plus source certificate, not on novel rederivation of every 90×90 rational kernel.

value.rationale: Scientific value PASS: the ordinary matching complex of the Petersen graph is a canonical, natural flag complex with nonzero H2 and high symmetry. Determining its minimum integral homology supports, all 110 carriers, and the distinct integral generation indices of the S5 orbits resolves natural geometric questions not implied by the known wedge-of-spheres result. The rational S5 decomposition adds precise equivariant homology information. This is an exact finite classification of motivated objects, not an arbitrary tiny numerical slice.
residual_risks: The classification is particular to one graph and does not imply an algorithmic classification of all matching complexes; significance is intrinsic to this standard example.

final_claim: The ordinary Petersen matching complex has exactly 110 induced six-vertex octahedral S2 carriers, the minimum possible support for nonzero reduced H2=Z^5. These split into S5 orbits of sizes10,60,40 with H2/orbit-lattice quotients Z/2,0,0 respectively. Rational H2=sgn⊗Q^[5], H3=Specht(3,2); the known homotopy wedge of five S2 and five S3 is background.
